_comment: All dimensions in mm. Rim shape is an irregular quadrilateral: A=bottom-left, B=bottom-right, C=top-right, D=top-left.

vertices._comment: Inner edge of the rim (the edge the adapter sits against).

_ab_bulge: Inward curvature (sagitta) of the A-B edge. 0 = straight.
_wall: Wall thickness, added outward from the inner rim edge.

profile_test._thickness: Extrusion height (Z) of the flat test piece.

faceplate._wall_height: Height of the walls that wrap down over the rim.

port_hole._comment: Cutout through the cap for dust to pass. Vertices define its outline on the cap face.
port_hole._A: Construction vertex, deliberately outside the rim: pushed 12mm out along the old acute corner's bisector from the measured [5, 15] so the corner fillet lands as a rounded lobe that fills the lower corner (teardrop, like the saw's real opening). Only the tangent arc is part of the outline; verified >= 3mm inside the rim.
port_hole._fillets: Per-corner fillet radii. A's big radius + pushed-out vertex form the corner lobe; B and C share the short 15mm B-C edge, capping them around 7.

transition._hose_od: Outer diameter of the hose that plugs into the socket.
transition._hose_tolerance: Extra clearance added to hose_od for the socket ID.
transition._socket_depth: Depth of the female socket (how far the hose inserts).
transition._tube_wall: Wall thickness of the transition tube at the hose exit.
transition._tube_wall_base: Wall thickness at the faceplate end; tapers linearly to tube_wall at the exit. Thicker here because the near-flat base cross-sections run oblique to the tube surface.
transition._tube_length: Length of the transition tube along its centerline path (mm).
transition._exit_angle_deg: Angle of the tube exit face from vertical (degrees). 80 = nearly horizontal.
transition._path_angle_deg: Angle of the straight travel path from vertical. Negative means it leans backwards.
transition._exit_direction_deg: Horizontal direction the tube points (degrees). 0 = toward A-D edge. Positive rotates toward A-B edge.
transition._tilt_blend_start: Fraction of the tube over which the cross-section tilt is solved so the underside runs dead straight; past this the tilt sweeps up to exit_angle with a slope-matched cubic (zero rotation rate at the exit). Any fixed easing curve bows the underside somewhere; the solved schedule confines the bend to one gentle bow near the exit.
transition._path_bend_start: Fraction of the tube with a straight centerline; the remainder arcs from path_angle to exit_angle so the tube arrives tangent to the socket instead of creasing at the junction. 1.0 = no bend (centerline stays straight and the underside kinks ~15 degrees where it meets the socket).
transition._morph_ease_exp: Quad-to-circle morph easing exponent (1-(1-t)**q). 1 = linear morph; >1 shrinks the quad toward the circle early.
transition._num_loft_stations: Number of intermediate cross-sections along the tube.
transition._num_profile_points: Points sampled around each cross-section for quad-to-circle morph.
